_note: Approved untracked roots for ops/untracked-anomaly-report.py (Repo Hygiene Program R02). A path under an approved root is EXPECTED to be untracked and is not an anomaly. Everything else untracked-but-not-ignored in the canonical checkout appears in the weekly report. The report pages nobody and blocks nothing.
_two_lists_on_purpose: structural roots are plumbing this repo creates for itself and are approved by their own existing doctrine. ruled roots are debris families the R01 settlement has actually ruled keep-and-ignore; the list starts EMPTY because on 2026-09-01 the R01 worksheet's dispositions are all advisory ('owner self-identifies in the landing window') and an advisory disposition is not a ruling. Adding a root here without a recorded ruling is how a debris family disappears from review by accident.
_adding_a_ruled_root: one entry per ruling, with the ruling reference and the date. No wildcards beyond a trailing slash, so nobody can silence a family with a broad pattern.

structural.why: receipts, run records and program artifacts; load-bearing and written by design. Also in .gitignore.
